The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] had to change [[transport]]s on a '''planet''' with [[Color|green]] [[color]]ed skies while trying to flee [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bronk encountered a pair of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who tried to arrest him on his way to his transport at [[Pad 560]], but Kenobi saved him, allowing him to successfully leave the world.<ref name="Inc" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet first appeared in "[[Incognito]]," a short story by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[John Jackson Miller]] and illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]], which was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 143|143]] in [[2013]]. The story served as a tie-in to Jackson's novel [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']], which was released later that year.
